items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Mona's half sick... Cab says to me... Find out from Mona how much it costs... you and Mona come on over on Friday.

ctx.x: Cab also, had that front, that would scare people a little bit too. But you knew the kind of person he really is, for instance with your first born.

Oh, that’s right, well I says, “Cab my wife is pregnant.” He say, “Yeah, mine too.” He say, “Have this one on me.” So the baby was born, you know, Charlotte was born, and three months later we’re in California and I’m trying to make a two o’clock feed and make the gig that night and Mona’s half sick, and Cab says to me, “Look man I told you to have that baby on me. Find out from Mona how much it costs for everything.” Back in those days it cost about $300 for prenatal care. And he just laid it out to me, man, it…
for him to really be able to write what a great personality he was. He wasn’t that much older. I’m 85, Cab was 87, 88, but he was so far ahead of us in being —

items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Your wife was there, my wife was there

ctx.x: Your wife was there, my wife was there, Basie’s wife was there. Woody and Lionel was there. The band was —
Oh, yeah, friends of Ellington. Yeah.
